opening.argument: The offer pairs a $5,800 Bitcoin retirement course with a displayed “guaranteed” promise to help professionals become work-optional 10 years earlier. That commercial promise is reinforced by repeated encouragement to purchase Bitcoin, including the statement that “you can buy a dollar a week if you want to,” while the speaker links Bitcoin holdings to retirement and future appreciation. He predicts, “Bitcoin will keep going up, and that 0.1 Bitcoin's value will also keep going up,” and presents a calculation under which about 20 coins could support complete retirement at $70,000 in annual expenses. Although he concedes, “Bitcoin's price could go down significantly,” the guarantee's terms, calculation assumptions, and any realized outcomes are not established. The combination of paid access, guaranteed timing, purchase encouragement, and promised appreciation supports the stated concern.
